title: openclaw_review_action_protocol
description: Contract describing the 5 review actions OpenClaw frontend can emit per FMEA row.

confirm.purpose: Reviewer accepts the AI draft row as-is.

edit.purpose: Reviewer modifies one or more fields. The patch carries new values.

reject.purpose: Reviewer marks row as not applicable to current scope.

defer.purpose: Reviewer cannot conclude now, asks to revisit.

promote_to_case.purpose: Reviewer confirms row AND explicitly requests writing it into case_library as a new historical case.
promote_to_case.note: Implies confirm semantics. Routes the row to case_library writeback regardless of evidence_grade.

ordering: If multiple actions target the same row_id, last-write-wins by reviewed_at timestamp.
idempotency: Re-applying the same action file MUST produce the same result. Scripts must read the latest action per row_id rather than appending.
